sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: ebBRET assay (L3): DuET 5-HT4R recruits p11-RLuc to the plasma membrane (CAAX-rGFP reporter), statistically significant vs. pcDNA control (P<0.05, one-way ANOVA). Membrane IP (L2): construct recovered from membrane lysate by 1D4 antibody pull-down, confirming membrane-anchored expression.
sites.rationale: HTR4 has no signal peptide (per-residue topology begins 'O' at residue 1; EC1 spans 1–19); the N-terminus is extracellular and is the only extracellular terminus of this 7-TM receptor. The DuET construct places a FLAG tag at the N-terminus, which by topology can only be at insert_after_residue=0 (prepend before M1). Python confirms seq[0]='M' and TM1 begins at residue 20, leaving 19 residues of extracellular N-terminal space well clear of the TM boundary. The construct is functional: ebBRET demonstrates p11 membrane recruitment indistinguishable from the assay's positive benchmark. FLAG-5HT4R-1D4 (DuET construct) expressed in HEK293T cells; N-terminal FLAG tag on full-length, membrane-anchored HTR4. No signal peptide (topology begins extracellular at residue 1); the N-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus, making insert_after_residue=0 the only possible surface position. Construct used in membrane immunoprecipitation (L2) and ebBRET p11 membrane-recruitment assay (L3).

sources.claim: We used dual epitope-tagged (DuET) ( 20 ) versions of these receptors, engineered to contain N-terminal FLAG and C-terminal 1D4 epitope tags, alongside a p11 construct containing tandem C-terminal OLLAS epitope tags.

literature_notes: All five ledger lines derive from a single paper (PMC13626081). L1–L3 describe the same FLAG-5HT4R-1D4 DuET construct; L1 is used as the primary supporting clip because it introduces the construct. L4 describes a C-terminal NLuc variant (replacing 1D4); both C-terminal tags fall in IC4 (residues 316–388, intracellular) and are recorded in other_positions. L5 describes chimeric 5-HTR constructs with no new junction information. No ledger line names a specific residue for the FLAG insertion; the position is topology_derived from the sole extracellular terminus. No internal extracellular loop insertions are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 1D4 epitope tag in the DuET construct; residue 388 (T) lies in IC4 (316–388, intracellular) and is not accessible from the extracellular face.
C-terminal NanoLuciferase (NLuc) tag replacing the 1D4 tag via Gibson assembly; same intracellular C-terminus (IC4: 316–388), not a surface site.
